body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> iLuv, the leader in innovative solutions dedicated to developing unique accessories for Apple's iPhone and iPod, is proud to the unveil the iLuv App Station, an App-driven Rotational Alarm Clock Dock for iPhone and iPod users. iLuv will debut the App Station and showcase their award winning line of products including the iEA15 iPod Remote Adapter and the iAD115 Micro USB Car Charger, all CES 2010 Innovations Design and Engineering Award Honorees in the Portable Multimedia Accessories, the Headphone Product and the In-Vehicle Accessory categories. iLuv's App Station, a new concept dock for iPhone and iPod fanatics, featuring a unique application that transforms it into a music listening, movie watching, alarm clock dock, will be debuted at this years show along with iLuv's entire innovative line.

"iLuv is proud to be named CES Innovations 2010 Design and Engineering Award Honorees in three categories for our newest inventions, especially the App Station Rotational Alarm Clock dock for iPhone and iPod which will debut at CES 2010" said Sean Cho, iLuv director of marketing and strategic planning. "iLuv has a long tradition of being recognized with the CES Innovations awards and 2010 could not have been any different. We always strive to bring high quality products with innovative designs at smart prices to iPod and iPhone fans and are proud to be recognized by the CE industry as one of the best."

The App Station, an App-driven Rotational Alarm Clock Dock, is an innovative Application Driven portable desktop speaker for the iPhone and iPod fanatics. The most salient feature of the App Station is the iLuv Application (available from the Apple App store) which allows you to transform the App Station into a large digital display alarm clock with customizable settings and looks to match your style and preference. With vertical or horizontal standing options the App Station provides you with the capability of watching movies or simply listening to music. The concept will debut at CES 2010 and will be available for sale in February 2010. The customized iLuv App will be available for download from the iTunes App Store for free following the release of the App Station rotational alarm clock dock. MSRP $129.99.

The iAD115 Micro USB Car Charger, released in September 2009 for $14.99 MSRP, is a part of a new series of car chargers that are the perfect solution for the iPod, iPhone, MP3, GPS and other gadget lovers who need a power boost while on the go. For those with multiple devices, the iAD119 Dual USB Car Charger allows you to charge two devices at once. www.i-luv.com

The iEA15 iPod Remote Adapter for any third party earphones and headphones, released last summer for $14.99 MSRP, is the ideal solution for iPod music lovers looking for a way to control their iPod music playing functions without having to take it out of their pocket. iPod users can attach the iEA15 remote adapter to any standard pair of earphones or headphones without sacrificing sound quality. This lightweight and ultra portable solution also supports the Voiceover feature on the iPod shuffle 3rd generation and is easy to install, simply plug and play. www.i-luv.com
For more information on product specifications as well as pricing and availability please visit www.i-luv.com.
